text_frame.text: CyberMind AI is an AI-powered Cyber Threat Intelligence and Malware Analysis Platform designed to consolidate heterogeneous sources and provide concise, actionable outputs for analysts. The system integrates rule-based scanners, machine learning detectors and generative AI explanations to produce a unified 0–100 cyber risk score and automated reports.
